premises.text: Creators face challenges in hiring, finding introductions, and accessing expertise.
premises.evidence_span: as creators, we know the pain associated with building a business. You're looking to hire, you're looking to be hired, you're looking for an introduction, or maybe an expert.

premises.text: Namesake leverages social graphs to match users with business opportunities.
premises.evidence_span: We take the power of your social graph, meaning Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn, and couple it with our real-time infrastructure to make publishing, routing, and matching happen like magic.

premises.text: The platform enhances the process of matching supply with demand in markets.
premises.evidence_span: Markets are about matching supply with demand.

premises.text: The stream interface allows users to post and route business opportunities effectively.
premises.evidence_span: the core difference is our stream's ability to route business opportunities.

premises.text: Users can apply for opportunities directly through the platform.
premises.evidence_span: we have the ability to apply for these things in line, to apply or the relevant opportunity to make introductions.

premises.text: Trust is built through identity and endorsements on the platform.
premises.evidence_span: the first piece of trust online is identity.

value.text: Namesake facilitates easier connections and opportunities for creators.
value.evidence_span: we've made it ten times more useful for him.
